changes.reason: Preserve per-document index/delete effect admission order while retaining event singleflight, failure redelivery and independent document progress. Reuse the existing SearchEngine and tenant Context boundaries.

kubernetes.reason: Per-instance document effect ordering uses only promises and an in-memory map, without Kubernetes Node Host capabilities, provider I/O changes or storage requirements.
